newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico to earn $100 mln from Latam power projects.
newsitem.headline: Mexico to earn $100 mln from Latam power projects.

text.p: Mexico's Federal Electricity Commission (CFE) expects to earn $100 million from 1996 to 2000 from commercialising its know-how and helping in power projects in Latin America, the government agency said in a statement Wednesday.
CFE's international affairs director Cesar Garcia said the agency will be studying, designing, engineering and supervising construction of projects in cooperation with other Latin American nations.
The commission has already trained personnel from Colombia, Peru, Ecuador, Argentina, Guatemala, Costa Rica and Bolivia, he said.

He added that future projects include participation in the Miravalles II geothermal plant in Costa Rica and Bolivia's Laguna Colorada geothermal plant, maintenance at thermoelectric centers Gonzalo Zevallos 2 and 3 and Esmeraldas in Ecuador and installation of a Mexico-Belize transmission line to sell energy to Belize.
